description: Conceptual current MLFF dependency and ownership graph for the P1-P5 campaign lifecycle. It contains one global target-size authority, one selected binding, selected-only method validation, and fresh final production; downstream qualification is reserved for a separate activated consumer.

node_classes.evidence: Immutable physical or model-derived evidence with an explicit statistical role.
node_classes.policy: Normative scientific/statistical policy owned by one current specification family.
node_classes.fitted_product: A product fitted only inside an authorized training partition and bound to its inputs.
node_classes.scientific_product: A current scientific workflow product whose identity is independent of execution realization.
node_classes.execution_product: A current runtime/publication product constrained by the scientific architecture.
node_classes.validation_product: Evidence that may evaluate a frozen protocol but cannot retroactively control forbidden upstream decisions.

edge_type_definitions.consumes: The downstream product may inspect the upstream current authority under its declared statistical role.
edge_type_definitions.fit_domain_requires: The downstream fitted product may inspect only the authorized training domain.
edge_type_definitions.produces: The upstream authority deterministically or policy-conditionally produces the downstream product.
edge_type_definitions.promotion_requires: Downstream promotion requires the upstream predicate/evidence to pass.
edge_type_definitions.validates_after_freeze: The downstream validation product is activated only after the upstream protocol/decision is frozen and cannot control that upstream decision.
edge_type_definitions.identity_requires: The downstream identity binds the exact upstream scientific identity.
edge_type_definitions.optional_enrichment: The upstream product may enrich the downstream current path without creating a second semantic owner.

nodes.owner: downstream calibration contract (reserved; not a P6 campaign owner)
nodes.summary: Reserved calibration evidence role; it cannot alter the current selected binding or method.

nodes.owner: downstream locked-test contract (reserved; not a P6 campaign owner)
nodes.summary: Reserved sealed-evaluation role; it is unavailable to current target-size and method decisions.
One P_train/M3 target-size development split derived from the canonical frame authority and the neutral statistical substrate.
One deterministic training order pi_train whose exact prefixes T_N = pi_train[:N] are the candidate target subsets.
One deterministic evaluation order pi_eval and its nested direct populations M1 subset M2 subset M3.
One deterministic preparation identity shared unchanged by every candidate size and every optimizer seed.
The CampaignStore terminal projection binding N_selected to the exact T_selected membership digest.
All-required-fold, all-required-seed target-only acceptance of the training method on exactly T_selected.
Fresh production training on the complete exact T_selected under the accepted method and an independent production horizon.
The configured target-size policy: candidate ladder, configured ceiling, fidelity boundaries, ordered optimizer seeds, and the metric/practical-equivalence rule.

forbidden_current_paths: retired multi-view selector/repair/qualification state -> current target-size authority
retired target-size migration or reconstruction helper -> current campaign preparation or restart
locked-test evidence -> target-size decision or training/checkpoint policy
pool cardinality or monitor cardinality -> implicit selected target size
per-candidate independent preparation -> current nested target subsets
replay-monitor metrics or diagnostics -> target-size ranking/qualification/tie-break
current campaign execution -> consequential storage compaction/deduplication/archival (deferred to CODE-MLFF-CAMPAIGN-STORAGE-IO-RESET1)
post-production qualification evidence -> final publication membership, production member/seed/checkpoint selection, or cross-validation acceptance
resource_invariants: one fitted selection-input authority per required training domain
one canonical training order pi_train and one canonical evaluation ladder per experiment identity
one common target-size preparation shared by every candidate size and optimizer seed
candidate rungs represented as prefix metadata/views
training artifacts materialized only for candidates authorized by the successive-fidelity funnel
execution caches reconstructible and bounded; execution realization cannot alter scientific identity or decisions
